narrative:
You step forward onto the frost-rimed flags of the Ashen Bridge, boots crunching against the grey grit. The iron-tipped shafts of the sentry-guard drop instantly, forming a rigid fence of ash-wood and gleaming steel that blocks the span. The Sentry Captain pushes past the barrier, his heavy greaves ringing sharply against the stone. He steps directly into your personal space, the reek of cheap pipeweed and damp leather rolling off his breastplate. With a gauntleted hand, he shoves you back a half-pace by the shoulder, his voice dropping into a harsh, grating rasp.

"You walk slow for a man with no blood on his boots," the captain snarls, his hand resting deliberately on the pommel of a notched broadsword at his hip. The other guards lock their eyes upon you, their knuckles whitening around their spears. "State your business in the grey ward before I have these lads throw your carcass into the gorge."

choices.text: Give a false name and claim you are a merchant seeking shelter from the fog
Glare back at the captain and place a hand firmly over the hilt of your weapon
Step away from the spear-tips and ask which commander currently holds the gate
Drop into a low stance and eye the space between the sentry's legs for a sudden sprint

extractedMemories.summary: The Sentry Captain at the Ashen Bridge is hostile, suspicious, and currently blocks the gate.
